_comment: Pinned WiX Toolset used by build/build-msi.ps1 to produce the MSI. v3.14.1 rather than v5+ on purpose: the WiX v4+ binary releases are offered under an Open Source Maintenance Fee EULA that the build refuses to accept on anyone's behalf (error WIX7015), while v3.14.1 is plain MS-RL with no fee clause. GitHub windows runners ship v3.14 preinstalled, but the pipeline unpacks this pinned copy anyway so a workstation and a runner build with identical bits. build/fetch-wix.ps1 fails closed if the download does not match sha256.
